how_to_use: kind_cases: fold the card's kind from card, events and projects (catalogue entries) and compare with expected (review_kind, source, project_ids in catalogue order). passage_cases: stamp is the passage an answer on the card would carry now (null: none); passage_changed is section 6.3 (shown for project cards only). due_cases: scheduled_due_at is what the knowledge schedule gives; expected.due_at is the card's due time (compare as instants). The results must not depend on the order of events: test the given order and its reverse.

kind_cases.name: old_server_project_without_review_kind
kind_cases.note: A catalogue entry without review_kind is a knowledge Project.

kind_cases.name: held_by_filename
kind_cases.note: The card names no document ID; its PDF file is a Project document.

kind_cases.name: held_by_target
kind_cases.note: The card is on the Project's combined reading PDF.

kind_cases.name: held_by_document_id_with_other_filename
kind_cases.note: The card's document ID decides even if the file was renamed.

kind_cases.name: two_projects_one_project
kind_cases.note: Any project Project that holds the card makes it a project card.

kind_cases.name: record_kind_project
kind_cases.note: The card was made as a project card (record review_kind).

kind_cases.name: follow_project_ignores_record
kind_cases.note: follow_project drops the record's kind too.

kind_cases.name: instants_not_strings_fraction
kind_cases.note: 10:00:00.500Z is later than 10:00:00Z although it sorts first as a string.

kind_cases.name: invalid_events_ignored
kind_cases.note: Unknown kind, no time, a time without a zone, another card's event.

kind_cases.name: duplicate_event_ids_first_copy
kind_cases.note: Copies of one event are one event.

passage_cases.name: answer_without_stamp
passage_cases.note: Answers from before this capability are never marked.

passage_cases.name: same_segments_other_order
passage_cases.note: Compared as a map, not as a list.

passage_cases.name: card_on_imported_pdf
passage_cases.note: No source segments: no stamp, never marked.

passage_cases.name: segment_without_hash
passage_cases.note: A segment without content_sha256: no stamp, never marked.

passage_cases.name: retracted_answer_does_not_count
passage_cases.note: Take back this answer: the answer before it counts.

due_cases.name: swapped_card_old_interval_capped
due_cases.note: A knowledge card with a 60-day interval made a project card.

due_cases.name: changed_project_due_at_change
due_cases.note: The record was updated after the answer: due then.

due_cases.name: changed_project_record_time_earlier
due_cases.note: updated_at before the answer: due at the answer's time.
